bio_am: Ծնած է Շուշի՝ 1879-ին։ Պահեստի սպայ եւ հայդուկապետ, ինկաւ 1904-ին իր խումբին հետ։
bio_en: Tuman Tumants, known as Torgom, was born in Shushi on 1 May 1879 and graduated brilliantly from the diocesan school there alongside Aram, Ishkhan, Isajan and Menak. In 1897 he went to Moscow, audited natural-science courses and then served in the army, leaving as a reserve officer; he held that rebellion and battle were 'a craft and a science that must be learned'. Presenting himself to the ARF committee still in uniform, he devoted himself entirely to the revolution, and in 1903-04 led mounted bands such as 'Mrrik' and 'Orskan' across the border toward Sasun. He was killed with his band in 1904, and Aram wrote his biography immediately afterwards.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death in the destruction of the 'Orskan' band near Zardanis (#582) in summer 1904 - check #582. Quotes #28 and #71 are his.
